maddeler.e:
نتناظر (form VI)
# نَتَنَاظَرُ (natanāẓaru) /na.ta.naː.ðˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
# نَتَنَاظَرَ (natanāẓara) /na.ta.naː.ðˤa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
# نَتَنَاظَرْ (natanāẓar) /na.ta.naː.ðˤar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاظَرَ (tanāẓara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
